summary: ProKidney Corp. filed an 8-K on May 15, 2026, to report Q1 2026 financial results and an updated investor presentation. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure under Items 2.02 and 7.01, not a special situation. The company discusses Phase 3 PROACT 1 enrollment and topline results expectations, but no corporate event such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is mentioned. The document does not contain any deal terms or transactional mechanics.
